description: Attack Patterns are a type of TTP that describe ways that adversaries attempt to compromise targets. Attack Patterns are used to help categorize attacks, generalize specific attacks to the patterns that they follow, and provide detailed information about how attacks are performed. Clusters imported from STIX Attack Pattern objects. Each cluster keeps the STIX version of the object it comes from (2.0, 2.1, ...) in its `spec_version` meta field.
name: STIX Attack Pattern
